claims.claim_ar: يُجَوَّزُ أنْ تُحْمَلَ عبارةُ «عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ» بِالْجَرِّ على أنْ تَكُونَ صِفَةً لِـ «رَبِّي» أَوْ بَدَلًا منه.
claims.claim_en: It is permissible to take the phrase 'عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ' in the genitive as either a descriptive adjective (sifa) for 'my Lord' (رَبِّي) or as a substitute (badal) for it — i.e., the phrase may be attached to رَبِّي.

warnings: The cited passage in al-Tibyan discusses the phrase «عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ». That exact phrase does not appear as a contiguous word-sequence in the provided tokenization of S34:50; the extraction maps the author’s remark about attachment to the word رَبِّي (word_index 13: «رَبِّي»). Verify that applying this commentary to this verse (إِلَيَّ رَبِّي in S34:50) is intended.
